answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue by reporting qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memories 44 and 73 report strong commercial outcomes, but omit realized long-term revenue, retention, or unit economics. Memory 31 shows a durable activation lift but no downstream revenue evidence. Memories 86 and 91 establish only early behavioral improvements; memory 91 is least supported because it reports week-one engagement and first-action nudges without durability, adoption, conversion, revenue quality, or retention outcomes.
